Der NDR erteilt gegebenenfalls konkrete Vollmachten, damit der Auftragnehmer den NDR bei der Beschaffung der Genehmigung vertreten kann. 7 Schadensverhütung vor Ort (vgl. §§ 4 und 10 VOL/B) 7.1 Der Auftragnehmer ist verpflichtet, die staatlichen Arbeits- schutz- und Unfallverhütungsvorschriften sowie die all- gemein anerkannten sicherheitstechnischen und arbeits- medizinischen Regeln in vollem Umfang zu erfüllen. Der Auftragnehmer hat auf Anforderung des NDR einen entsprechenden Nachweis zu führen. Der Auftragnehmer sichert zu, dass die zu liefernden Geräte – soweit anwendbar – die grundlegenden Anforderungen der CE- Zertifizierung der Europäischen Union erfüllen und entsprechend gekennzeichnet sind. 7.2 Bei elektrischen Geräten und stromführenden Objekten (wie z.B. mobile Verteiler und Verlängerungskabel), die von Dienstleistern bzw. Auftragnehmern als notwendige Arbeitsmittel mit in Betriebsstätten des NDR gebracht werden, hat der Auftragnehmer eigenständig sicherzu- stellen, dass diese nach Maßgabe der DGUV Vorschrift 3 geprüft sind und damit betriebssicher eingesetzt werden können. Weiter gewährleistet der Auftragnehmer in eige- ner Verantwortlichkeit die Einhaltung der Betriebssicher- heitsverordnung in Bezug auf alle mitgebrachten Arbeitsmittel.

Enclosed please find the Request for Quotation (RFQ) package, including the proposed technical specifications, for the Procurement of Printing Services for the U.S. Embassy in Hanoi, covering the period November 2026 to December 2030. If you would like to submit a quotation, please complete the required portions of the attached document and submit it to the address indicated on the Standard Form 18 included with this letter. Your submission must include the following: - Standard Form 18: Complete blocks 11e & 11f (Price), and blocks 13, 14, 15 and 16 (Bidder’s information) - Pricing: As per RFQ Section C - Technical Proposal: As required in RFQ - NDAA certification Your quotation must be submitted electronically to HanoiGSOProcurement

Answers from the Embassy will be issued no later than October 15, 2026 local time. The U.S. Government intends to establish the Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) with the responsible offerors submitting the lowest-priced, technically acceptable quotation that meets all solicitation requirements. Purpose This Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP) is a Government developed and applied document used to ensure the systematic Quality Assurance (QA) methods are used in the administration surveillance of tasking under the Contract. The intent is to ensure the Contractor performs In Accordance With (IAW) the Performance Work Statement (PWS) and the Government receives the quality of services called for in the FFP contract. The Contractor shall deliver fully operational, integrated, and sustained EW SITE systems and sub-system components for domestic and Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The required outcome is an EW SITE system capable of supporting a multitude of laboratory-specific System Configurations across multiple platforms (EA-18G, F/A-18, MH-60) while maintaining configuration consistency with the Advanced Weapons Laboratory (AWL) at NAWCWD China Lake, CA. Additionally, the Contractor shall ensure continuous operational readiness of current EW SITE systems through comprehensive lifecycle support, including on-call and on-site maintenance, system upgrades, replacement parts provisioning, and personnel training. This Contract will have FFP CLINs. The Contract will have a five-year period of performance. A properly executed QASP will assist the Government in achieving the objectives of this procurement. 2. When preparing a competitive quotation, vendors should take into consideration benefits provided through the national healthcare system. Quotations should refrain from over customization, and should be “off the shelf”, “commercially available”, or “market ready” products which are designed to be complementary and supplement to the national system in Portugal. The benefit levels listed from section C.1.1 through C.1.24 are a standard package that must be provided. C.1.1 Eligibility: To be eligible to participate in the medical plan, LE Staff (both full time and part time) must be: -- Paid under the terms of the Local Compensation Plan (LCP); and – -- Under a non-temporary direct hire appointment, personal services agreement (PSA), or personal services contract (PSC); or -- Under a temporary direct hire appointment or PSA Fixed Term of one year or more. Not eligible are those working under temporary appointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor l

ointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor licensed to do business in Portugal who provides services to other local RFP 19GE5026Q0035 – LES Health Insurance Services for U.S. Embassy Lisbon Page 6 of 21 organizations as well as to the U.S. Mission; employees working on an intermittent or When Actually Employed (WAE) schedule; Peace Corps personal services contractors and Recreation Association employees. C.1.2 Riders: There are no riders under this contract. C.1.3 Periods of Ineligibility: Employees and their dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment for which premiums are not paid. Additionally, employee's dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment during which the employee was not eligible to participate. During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

All fakturering til Harstad kommune og samarbeidskommuner som inngår i kontrakten, må gjennomføres i Elektronisk Handels Format (EHF). Godkjente standardformater er EHF fakturering versjon 3.0 eller nyere og PEPPOL BIS (PEPPOL Business Interoperability Specification) Billing v3.0 eller nyere. Dette dokumentet omfatter bestemmelser om hvordan elektronisk fakturering gjennomføres for Harstad kommune med samarbeidskommuner, i EHF-formatet. Dokumentet beskriver kun de spesifikke informasjonselementene kommunene sender og har behov for å motta fra leverandøren. Obligatorisk innhold i EHF3.0 omhandles ikke i denne spesifikasjonen, slik som virksomhetsadresser, mva. håndtering, kontoopplysninger og lignende. Anticipated Time to Award The Government anticipates making any resulting award or agreement by March 2027, subject to the completion of the evaluation process, availability of funds, selection of the appropriate acquisition pathway and applicable approvals. This is an estimate only and does not obligate the Government to make an award. Notice: DHA reserves the right to award one or multiple contracts or agreements under this AOI.
